query: What methods can be used to report instances of bribery demands made by hospital staff within a governmental institution?
reference_answer:
Reporting Bribery Demands:
To report bribery demands by a government hospital staff, contact the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Department (DVAC) or the local police station. You can also call the toll-free helpline 1064 or file a complaint online on the TN Government website.
answer: To report instances of bribery demands made by hospital staff within a governmental institution, one should contact the ethics hotline, report it to the hospital's compliance office, or file a complaint with the relevant government department. [Document 1]
